output.message: Base case gives NPV £487,190, ROI 614% and payback 15.2 months. The spread runs from NPV £90,728 at 26.6 months in the pessimistic case to £1,115,809 at 8.1 months optimistic. New customer firms per year moves the result most: base-case NPV is zero at 46 a year.

Evidence supports a real gap: inspection tracking recurs in lost deals and support requests, and the rules engine works on the existing job model. Feasibility is sound, but willingness to pay is unproven and spreadsheet migration is messy. Financials clear the policy bar, so invest now is defensible; I would still pilot to buy proof. Agents disagree on market size and adoption, not on the build.
